results.pair_summary: Doc A defines the ABI contract, freeze status, and high-level invariants for observation types (world, registry, ancestry, diff) in version r2-0-c. Doc B provides the concrete implementation details, data structures (vectors), and logic for these exact same types.
results.integration_rationale: Doc B contains the structural definitions required for Delta3 Kernel code generation, while Doc A holds critical ABI stability constraints and freeze metadata. Merging A's status and invariants into B creates a single, self-describing specification that ensures type safety and ABI compliance are enforced directly within the implementation definition, reducing cross-file dependency risks.
